value.rationale: The comparison separates two canonical 20-vertex cubic graphs with equal Roman minimum value. It identifies 18 consecutive weights with strict inequality and proves positive-fugacity reliability dominance for every z>0 by a positive polynomial factor, motivating the exact finite coefficient fact independently of any later general theorem. It is not a parameter-free count or routine scalar restatement.
